title: Rename a task
prompt: TaskItem is supplied. Rename(TaskItem task, string title) should return a copy of the task with the new title. Its Id and Done must stay the same. The starter returns the task unchanged.
hints: Which of the three values changes, and which two must be carried over?
with copies every value you do not mention.
checks: Practice.Rename(new TaskItem(1, "Pack", false), "Ship") == new TaskItem(1, "Ship", false)
Practice.Rename(new TaskItem(7, "Pack", true), "Ship") == new TaskItem(7, "Ship", true)
Practice.Rename(new TaskItem(2, "Pack", false), "") == new TaskItem(2, "", false)
checkLabels: Renaming task 1 to Ship must give task 1 with the title Ship.
A done task must still be done, with the same Id, after renaming.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Builds a fresh record and resets Done.
Treats a rename as a new task and drops the Id.

feedback: Compare all three values of the failing result with the task that went in. Only the title should differ.
